svg.title: One calendar, three search strategies
svg.desc: BFS minimizes steps; Dijkstra and A* minimize entry cost. Colored waves show actual expanded nodes; couriers follow returned paths. Animation timing is illustrative, not a speed benchmark. Reduced motion shows the original calendar and final statistics.
svg.text: Entry cost = 1 + level | S / G fixed | Playback speed is illustrative, not a benchmark
